title: tc-chat-minimap
description:
A rail of ticks beside a long chat, one per message the person sent – the one in view lit, the message on hover, a
click to jump – that follows the chat's scrolling.

label.description: What the rail is – its accessible name

current.description: The id of the message in view. Followed from the scrolling unless `manual`, and set by a jump

manual.description: Leaves `current` to the page: the rail neither follows the scrolling nor scrolls on a jump

tipSide.description: Which side of the rail a message shows on

text.description: The message as the person wrote it; shown on hover, and its length sets the tick's

target.description: The id of the message's element in the chat, when it isn't `id`
